data.prediction_policy: Reuse the frozen three-feature classifier without fitting,calibration,threshold selection or use of recorded_sex as a feature. Predict the greatest-probability class in the exported classes order;ties use the earlier class. Positive1 is the historical recorded income-above-$50K label,not qualification,merit or an intervention outcome.
data.estimands: For exactly these unweighted assessment rows,compare Female minus Male for:predicted-positive fraction;true-positive rate conditional on recorded positive label;false-positive rate conditional on recorded negative label;and recorded-positive fraction. Equalized-odds max absolute gap is max(abs(TPRgap),abs(FPRgap));also report which conditional component attains it(tie if within1e-12). Denominators use their own whole subgroup/class support;if a required class is absent,its rate is null rather than zero.
data.scope: Descriptive heldout-cohort disparity measurements only. The recorded historical sex categories and income labels are source measurement constructs;do not infer individual qualification,causal discrimination,legality,population prevalence or overall fairness from these rates. The census fnlwgt is not used:the target is this explicitly unweighted archived assessment cohort.

source_provenance.source_sha256_basis: SHA256 of the decompressed original adult.data archive member, not of the zip container.
source_provenance.original_source: Becker and Kohavi(1996),Adult,UCI DOI10.24432/C5XW20,extracted from1994census data. Only original adult.data is used,not adult.test.
source_provenance.model_creation: Benchmark-created coarse standardized L2 logistic classifier,C=.5,max_iter200,trained only on the first2000indices of NumPy default_rng(215).permutation(32561),using raw integer age/education-num/hours-per-week. Assessment uses the next1000disjoint indices. Model and source observations are real artifacts;this is not an original UCI model or historical reporting mistake.
source_provenance.row_identity: record_id adult-N stores original zero-based adult.data row index+1,formatted to five digits. No real-person identifier is supplied.
source_provenance.export: Only three unchanged numeric source features,unchanged Female/Male sex labels renamed recorded_sex,and exact binary mapping of original >50K/<=50K target are exported. Unused categorical missing values do not trigger source-row deletion or imputation.
source_provenance.method_read_scope: Marginal selection versus label-conditional TPR/FPR definitions;max absolute equalized-odds difference;construct-validity and context limitations. No generic fairness threshold or legal rule is imported.

provenance.kind: Public historical records and/or explicitly disclosed derived audit inputs; source-specific provenance is in the study record. Controlled numerical teaching fixtures make no experimental observation claim.
